flags.detail: POS Software Vendor (00-0000008) is not in the vendor master

account_suggestion.reason: The bill is a monthly subscription for point-of-sale software, which is a recurring software expense, not equipment.

outcome.explanation:
I looked up the vendor master by tax ID 00-0000008 and by the name "POS Software Vendor". Both searches came back empty. This vendor has never been set up, so invoice POS-77120 for $189.00 (the monthly fee for point-of-sale software on 3 terminals) has no vendor record to post against. There's also no PO behind it, and none of its remit-to bank details (Example Bank, account ending 8008) have been checked.

Before this goes any further, find out internally who ordered the subscription and get them to confirm the $189.00 monthly charge. Then send the vendor through normal new-vendor setup: get a W-9 or tax ID document, and confirm the bank account by calling a phone number you find independently, not one printed on the invoice. Ask whether recurring charges like this need a PO. Only then send the invoice back for approval.

I haven't drafted an email to the vendor, because the first step is checking inside the company. Bank details shouldn't be confirmed by replying to the sender anyway.
